The company exhibits a strong balance sheet with moderate leverage (Total Liabilities to Total Assets of ~51%), a robust current ratio of 2.35x, solid profitability with an operating margin of ~13.1%, and a very substantial retained earnings base relative to its asset size. However, given its mid-sized revenue base ($3.6B) and moderate absolute operating income, it lacks the global scale and diversification typical of high-grade investment entities, positioning it comfortably in the middle investment-grade tier.

DECISION: BBB
